description: Batch orchestrator for lowering a list of ATen ops to Neuron in parallel. Fans out one aten-op-lowering Implementer subagent per op, gates each on a deterministic script-computed acceptance verdict (verify_op_acceptance.py, not an LLM), opens a draft PR only on PASS, then fans out pr-review in parallel. Enforces no-cheating: upstream tests are the source of truth and new skips/xfails are rejected unless their reason is on the platform-limitation allowlist. Aggregates results, surfaces blocked ops, and iterates until PRs are clean.
name: aten-lowering-orchestrator
